SOURCE_DERIVED.description: Extraction of exact word and line bounding boxes directly from the PDF text layer or OCR engine at character/span level.
SOURCE_DERIVED.analysis: PyMuPDF (fitz) is currently invoked with page.get_text('text') which returns raw strings and linebreaks, but not raw bounding rects (get_text('blocks') or get_text('words')). Thus, chunk ingestion currently records page_number and chunk_index, but does not extract source-derived PDF coordinates.

PRESERVED_METADATA.description: Preservation of custom bounding box coordinates supplied in chunk metadata during ingestion.
PRESERVED_METADATA.analysis: Verified via test_citation_bounding_box_custom_metadata_preservation. When chunk metadata contains a valid bounding_box dict with keys (page, x, y, width, height), build_rag_context preserves the exact coordinates verbatim and serializes them to the frontend.

FALLBACK_SYNTHETIC.description: Standard deterministic US Letter viewport geometry generated when source-derived coordinates are absent.
FALLBACK_SYNTHETIC.analysis: Verified via test_citation_bounding_box_default_generation and test_multi_chunk_vertical_slot_distribution. For standard US Letter pages (612x792 pt, 72 pt margins), the system computes x=72, y=90 + (chunk_idx % 7)*85, width=468, height=65 pt, guaranteeing non-overlapping distribution and page containment.

UNAVAILABLE.description: Handling when neither metadata nor page geometry is available.
UNAVAILABLE.analysis: Defaults cleanly to page 1 standard viewport bounding box without raising exceptions or breaking UI rendering.

provenance_security_audit.page_number_tampering: VERIFIED — Ingestion validates page_number as a positive integer; negative or out-of-bounds page numbers fall back to page 1.
provenance_security_audit.coordinate_boundary_confinement: VERIFIED — All synthetic coordinates are strictly bounded within 0 <= x < 612 and 0 <= y < 792 pt.
provenance_security_audit.tenant_isolation_on_citation_access: VERIFIED — Message citations are scoped to tenant_id via MessageCitation model and conversation parent relationships.

future_roadmap_requirement.item: PyMuPDF Word-Level Span Bounding Box Ingestion
future_roadmap_requirement.implementation_note: Update app/parsers/pdf.py to call page.get_text('words') or page.get_text('blocks'), compute bounding box union for each chunk, and store in DocumentChunk.metadata['bounding_box'] to enable true SOURCE_DERIVED highlighting.
